scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w shared && npm run test:postgres -w backend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
